user_approval.source: explicit Codex task instruction through issue #30 and guarded course-correction/admission gates on 2026-08-13

observations.name: immutable_engine_artifact
observations.expected: One clean committed Engine tree produces and supplies the installed CAP-12 wheel.
observations.observed: Commit 41971bbbaf8b1dc482360377ed36d2547e13131e, tree 5a2b0bae59dc602317b1810294007619f2c934eb, produced epcsaft-0.2.0.dev0-cp313-cp313-linux_x86_64.whl with SHA-256 9b768bb769464cdb98efbc94b4bd2c5b1b2ced65fa82c97bd737d7b0f3cf31cf and public-signature identity sha256:85e9649bf699003044cbaca345b28d5d2e0c077e7656bbb2fd5ee72e4aa41bbd.

observations.name: source_and_warm_installed_gates
observations.expected: Source-only readiness is green and the complete warm installed-wheel gate remains below ten seconds.
observations.observed: Source-only affected checks passed in 0.33 s. The warm installed gate passed in 7.69 s: EOS 58, Equilibrium 48 with 16 slow exclusions, Regression 3, and Validation 4 with 12 slow exclusions.

observations.name: slow_numerical_falsifiers
observations.expected: Exact-state fugacity, source-reference derivatives, total observation Jacobians, branch purity, covariance semantics, typed failures, mixed-start accounting, and the admitted CAP-09 multiroot contract pass from the installed wheel.
observations.observed: Seven installed scientific tests passed with seven non-target tests deselected in 119.96 s; the CAP-09 multiroot falsifier passed in 8.86 s. The representative reactive fit took 46.19 s and each accepted exact-state Provider callback required one Provider evaluation.

observations.name: installed_source_neutral_tracer
observations.expected: A source-neutral public-API tracer uses real reusable inputs, validates the opaque owner receipt, and independently checks the exact total Jacobian.
observations.observed: The Held-2008/IAPWS tracer completed in 6.69 s, retained receipt SHA-256 2d885b972ee9a80da3019ea792e23ad4224aba9af842fcf4ae48f7f87e5da6eb and owner-receipt identity sha256:90f89bfeb100566187d475608bd65f1e9d37e5e90b24be1b255bedf31f98bf78, and had maximum scaled central-difference discrepancy 2.4373233680770526e-10.

observations.name: narrow_scientific_scope
observations.expected: Admission is limited to fixed-T,P homogeneous reactive observations on an immutable reference-anchored certified local state without a global-equilibrium claim.
observations.observed: Equilibrium owns the typed descriptors, values, exact total derivatives, local branch/state/search/phase receipts, source-reference derivative transfer, and canonical opaque receipt validation. Regression consumes those values and Jacobians through ParameterFit/FitResult/fit, owns residual and optimization policy, and does not promote parameters from diagnostic evidence.

observations.name: explicit_exclusions
observations.expected: CAP-12 does not silently claim coupled VLE, globality, reaction-correlation regression, application-specific behavior, or production finite-difference Jacobians.

preconditions: The exact Engine source and evidence commits remain reachable and unchanged.
The installed distribution originates only from the recorded non-editable wheel.
All active coordinates and every admitted row pass derivative and owner-contract preflight.
The continuation reference is immutable and branch selection remains pure across optimizer evaluation order.
expected_postconditions: Governance decision D-034 admits only the CAP-12 homogeneous reactive observation family.
Issue #31 builds on the admitted phase, parameter-receipt, branch, failure, and covariance contracts.
Downstream applications consume a later committed Engine wheel without source-checkout imports.
Parameter promotion remains subject to independent rank, validation, branch, and physical certification gates.
record.retry: Repeat only from an unchanged committed Engine tree and compare wheel, public-signature, input, split, and receipt hashes; any changed subject requires a new receipt and admission review.
stop_conditions: Any admitted row becomes non-evaluable or receives a fabricated numeric penalty.
Exact total derivatives fail the independent numerical tolerance.
Continuation becomes evaluation-order dependent or an alternative certified state makes branch selection ambiguous.
The installed module origin resolves outside site-packages or the wheel hash changes.
A result implies global phase stability or equilibrium without a supporting globality procedure.
record.reversibility: D-034 can be superseded by a new doctrine revision and receipt; the private source commits, wheel, and retained tracer remain immutable evidence.
record.irreversible_effects: None. No public release, external data mutation, or downstream parameter promotion is performed by this admission.
record.recovery_owner: The unified Engine owner must fail closed, supersede D-034 with hash-bound corrective evidence, and prevent CAP-13 or downstream use until the corrected installed artifact passes the same gates.
